Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class CollectionNode

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.CollectionNode
public final class CollectionNode extends Object
One entry in a REST collection tree — either a folder (which owns children) or a saved request (which owns request).

The saved request is kept as an opaque JsonNode rather than a typed request object: the exact field set lives in the REST view's own serializer, so the tree keeps working when that serializer gains a field. It nests in the on-disk file instead of being an escaped string blob.
